**7B.5 Research Note: Bongbong Marcos in 2024**

**Assessment:** mixed, leaning positive on competence-based staffing.  
The strongest 2024 evidence points to a technocratic economic team with real policy latitude and several institutional reforms that reduce patronage space. The strongest negative evidence is indirect: insider appointments, family-network influence around the Romualdez bloc, and politically salient regulatory leverage. I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of Marcos directly stuffing the cabinet with close family members or a documented bribe/donor-for-posts scheme.

- **Speech of President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. at the oath-taking and announcement of the new Department of Finance secretary and special assistant to the president for investment and economic affairs**. Presidential Communications Office, January 12, 2024. [URL](https://pbbm.com.ph/speeches/speech-of-president-ferdinand-r-marcos-jr-at-the-oath-taking-and-announcement-of-the-new-department-of-finance-secretary-and-special-assistant-to-the-president-for-investment-and-economic-affairs/)  
  Marcos framed Frederick Go and Ralph Recto as expertise-based choices, which is direct evidence for competence-based staffing rhetoric.  
  QIDs: 7B.5

- **Historical Data: Philippines, February 2024**. CIA, February 2024. [URL](https://www.cia.gov/resources/world-leaders/historical-data/2024-february/philippines)  
  The cabinet roster was mostly technocratic in the economic cluster, with named professionals rather than an obviously family-dominated team.  
  QIDs: 7B.5

- **Recto hits the ground running towards an inclusive future that benefits all Filipinos; introduces growth-enhancing roadmap in his first 100 days in office**. Department of Finance, April 29, 2024. [URL](https://www.dof.gov.ph/recto-hits-the-ground-running-towards-an-inclusive-future-that-benefits-all-filipinos-introduces-growth-enhancing-roadmap-in-his-first-100-days-in-office/)  
  Recto appears to have had real policy latitude, including fiscal recalibration and revenue changes, which is evidence of a staffed economic team rather than a ceremonial loyalist.  
  QIDs: 7B.5

- **Marcos’s economic managers publicly set out strategy together**. Philippine News Agency, July 8, 2024. [URL](https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1228524)  
  The government’s macro team publicly coordinated inflation, growth, and investment policy through NEDA, BSP, DBM, Treasury, and the investment office, suggesting professionalized governance.  
  QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.3

- **Marcos signed the New Government Procurement Act / procurement reform coverage**. Presidential Communications Office, July 20, 2024. [URL](https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-signs-laws-on-streamlining-procurement-combatting-online-scams/)  
  Procurement standardization and e-procurement reduce room for favoritism and patronage, which supports a cleaner administration rather than a crony one.  
  QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.3

- **PBBM issues EO No. 52 institutionalizing and expanding DSWD’s Pag-Abot Program**. Lawphil / Office of the President, January 18, 2024. [URL](https://lawphil.net/executive/execord/eo2024/eo_52_2024.html)  
  The program used an inter-agency committee, monitoring, and formal reporting, which is bureaucratic structure rather than informal family or loyalist allocation.  
  QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.3

- **Philippine president picks longtime lawmaker as new finance chief, media**. Reuters / Inquirer, January 11, 2024. [URL](https://business.inquirer.net/440545/ph-president-picks-longtime-lawmaker-as-new-finance-chief-media)  
  The main counterpoint is that Recto was a seasoned political insider rather than a pure technocrat, so the staffing picture is not cleanly nonpartisan.  
  QIDs: 7B.5

- **Reuters Institute digital news report: Philippines**. Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, June 17, 2024. [URL](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/philippines)  
  The report notes ABS-CBN’s TeleRadyo joint venture with Prime Media, associated with the Romualdez family, which is indirect evidence that family-linked business networks remained relevant under Marcos.  
  QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.4

- **Marcos and Romualdez parties forge political alliance**. BusinessWorld Online, May 8, 2024. [URL](https://www.bworldonline.com/the-nation/2024/05/08/593686/marcos-romualdez-parties-forge-political-alliance/)  
  The Marcos-Romualdez party alliance shows the family network remained fused to state and electoral strategy, which is a patronage risk even if not direct proof of nepotistic appointments.  
  QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.4

- **Reuters Institute digital news report: broadcaster pressure and franchise leverage**. Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, June 17, 2024. [URL](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/philippines)  
  The same report says regulatory pressure over broadcasters remained politically salient, showing office-linked leverage still mattered to connected actors.  
  QIDs: 7B.5, 7B.4

**Search gap:** I did not find reliable 2024 reporting or official records showing Marcos directly appointing close family members to top cabinet posts, paying donors with posts, or openly staffing government with obvious cronies/yes-men. The negative evidence is mostly indirect and network-based, not a direct appointment scandal.
